topic: What if your local gym had online membership?
hook: Imagine a gym in Phuthaditjhaba where members sign up from their phones.
caption:
Imagine a gym in Phuthaditjhaba where members sign up from their phones.

This is an illustrative concept, not a real client. But plenty of small businesses still run this way: sign-ups on paper, payments counted by hand, and renewals that depend on someone remembering.

A simple web application could change that. Members sign up and pay from their phones. The owner sees who has paid and who needs a reminder.

None of it needs to be complicated. It needs to fit how the business already works.

Which local business would you most like to see do this?
